name: Random Variable Augmentation for Optimization
aliases: Random Variable Augmentation for Discontinuity Sampling
definition: A technique to help convergence in shader optimization by augmenting parameters with uniformly distributed random variables, ensuring discontinuities (like Z-ordering or object boundaries) are sampled more often.
summary: Random Variable Augmentation optimizes volume rendering by adding noise to discrete parameters, enabling gradient estimation at discontinuities where vanilla methods fail.
